marks.gloss_en: our mishna: the carryings-out of Shabbat are two that are four inside, and two that are four outside
our mishna's first case: the poor man outside reached his hand inside and put [an object] into the homeowner's hand -- the poor man is liable and the homeowner exempt
the Shevuot mishna: oaths are two that are four
the homeowner reached his hand outside and put [an object] into the poor man's hand -- the homeowner is liable and the poor man exempt
the poor man reached his hand inside and the homeowner took [the object] from within it -- both are exempt
the homeowner reached his hand outside and the poor man took [the object] from within it -- both are exempt
